scope: H3MR Stage-3-BIR plus frozen V1 hard recovery and V2 ordinary-sequence VDA post-processing
summary: A one-command, GT-free candidate-generation pipeline reproduces the accepted H2O Train20 Adaptive VDA result and passes structural integrity audits without modifying the Stage-3-BIR source predictions.
evidence: A real replay processed 20 H2O Train20 sequences, 40 hand tracks, and 25,352 shared valid hand frames; candidate generation completed before the first GT read.
The frozen route selected subject1_ego__k2__2 for exact V1 dense recovery and the remaining 19 sequences for ordinary V2 processing.

Against the fixed Stage-3-BIR baseline, W-MPJPE changed from 24.995810 to 23.941061 mm, WA-MPJPE from 15.135565 to 14.584753 mm, RTE from 1.107845% to 1.031538%, and Accel from 6.442513 to 6.406733 m/s^2; PA-MPJPE remained numerically invariant.
The structural audit passed output SHA, finite-value, unchanged-field, valid-mask, camera-field, coordinate-consistency, reprojection, and within-hand geometry checks, with no temporary files.

Ten targeted Adaptive VDA and cache-adapter tests passed, git diff whitespace checks passed, and the public comparison asset is a 10-second, 300-frame, 1920x1080 H.264 video with SHA-256 11162a27f802e5179da17c07d30803dd55f32ca5228496f9f032393def1ab118.
lessons: VDA is safest as a confidence-gated world-translation correction that preserves camera-space hand predictions and BIR outputs, rather than as an unconditional replacement for the full SLAM trajectory.
Separating candidate generation from GT evaluation and freezing candidate hashes is required to support causal attribution of the measured increment to Adaptive VDA.
The frozen V1 difficult-sequence route and the V2 ordinary-sequence route solve different failure regimes and should remain explicit in both code and reporting.
limitations: The evidence is from the H2O Train20 development split under a GT-2D upper-bound protocol and does not establish independent test-set generalization.
Not every ordinary sequence improves every metric; the aggregate result must not be described as universal per-sequence improvement.
This release consumes precomputed Stage-3-BIR predictions, VDA depth observations, scale evidence, and a frozen V1 hard-sequence candidate; it does not package upstream model checkpoints.
next_actions: Evaluate the frozen method on a predeclared independent challenge set without selecting sequences from final GT improvements.
Report Native, scale-only, dense-only, V1-only, V2-only, and adaptive routes under one frozen validity and evaluation protocol.
